MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The Piano Guys felt like a natural next choice because instrumental arrangements and familiar melodies fit my most recent interest in relaxing classical music.",
    "Alone in Iz World and Emerald: Musical Gems Deluxe appealed through gentle vocals and polished, expressive singing, while Windy City matched the softer country sound I enjoy."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "Hamilton connects with my musical-theater interest, but its energetic delivery does not fit the gentler listening I want right now.",
    "The Christmas albums connect with earlier listening, but I am not currently in a seasonal mood; Cowboy Songs also feels too loosely related to the softer country music I prefer.",
    "Time and The River and Something Beautiful gave me too little evidence of a musical fit to choose them over options I could connect more clearly with my taste."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My past Christmas listening seemed to count too strongly as a reason to want more Christmas music today.",
    "Broad connections to theater or country seemed to matter more than whether the particular sound would feel gentle and relaxing."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My latest relaxing classical selection better reflects my current mood and makes soothing instrumental arrangements especially appealing.",
    "The qualities connecting many of my choices are expressive voices, melodic arrangements, and a softer sound; sharing a broad musical style alone is not enough."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognized my interest in melodic singing and instrumental music, but gave too much weight to older seasonal interests and too little to my current relaxing mood."
}
